Name: Phineas
Dialog: A little bit more to the left. To the left of the pickles. Perfect!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, Phineas! Whatcha do—Whoa! That's a lotta deli!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's more than that! It's an actual submarine sandwich submarine. I can't believe we hadn't thought of it sooner.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh, sure. Ya like this bread-related activity, but not mine!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Are you still going on about that Bread Bowl Hot Tub?

Name: Buford
Dialog: It's a looooong summer, and I am a patient man.

Name: Linda
Dialog: So I hope the sandcastle-building queen is ready to defend her crown today!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, yeah, building castles made of sand. I know it's today, Mom, but I've got bigger fish to fry. The boys are building the biggest and stupidest thing in Phineas and Ferb history. Wait till you see this ridiculous overly literal monstrosity!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, hey, hey! Don't let your thing with your brothers distract you! Not today! Your unlimited sandcastle potential is at stake!

Name: Candace
Dialog: But but but but...

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, I'm heading to the beach now with my famous sub sandwiches. I'll see ya there, winner!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, yea, you'll see me. And you'll also see what the boys are making!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And this is what the sandwich would look like in a storm.

Name: The gang
Dialog: Oooh...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But today, we're gonna plant our flag in the deepest part of the ocean.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: The Mariana Trench! (falls over)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Mariana Trench? Then we're gonna need trench coats, right?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (happily) Sounds exciting! (concerned) And dangerous!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh, here we go! Li'l Miss Safety Patch strikes again!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Uh-uh-uh! (She unfurls her Fireside Girls sash.) Some would say I got most of these Safety Patches from pullin' your biscuits out of the fire.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I like my biscuits hot.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Anyway, we're gonna need high-pressure hull insulation, RADAR, SONAR, and a periscope.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Absolutely! Speaking of high-pressure hull insulation, where's Perry?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Intriguing segue.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Morning, Agent P, I—

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Wait, what? Why am I a sock puppet?

Name: Carl
Dialog: (offscreen) It's a filter, sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, turn it off! I hate it.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (offscreen) I dunno what button you hit.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Why would this even be an option?

Name: Carl
Dialog: It was part of the bundle.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Okay, it's funny when it's you. Heh heh. I'm just gonna roll with it. (He holds up a plate with a sandwich with a bite out of it.) Agent P, Doofenshmirtz has been stealing people's food right off their plates. It's rude even for him. Clearly, his mom didn't teach him... (He throws the plate offscreen, it crashes and the traditional cat screech is heard.) ...a lot of things, which is why we all have a job. So get to it, Agent P.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Eh, hold on, sir, I think I found the button.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Whoops!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (sighs) You're such a weenie, Carl.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Pericles the Platypus! I-I dunno what "Perry" is short for, so I'm just trying stuff out. 'Til you tell me any different, Pericles the Platypus, that-that's your name. In the meantime...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's the surf n' turf n' pus special. Y'see, you're the turf, and the lobster's the surf and... I guess you're also the surf, 'cause you're... you're semiaquatic and... Oh, never mind. Y'see, I'm stuck here waiting for my oven repairman who gave me a ridiculous window. And not this ridiculous window of me kicking an orange. Long story, don't even ask. I'm talking about a ridiculous window of time. From 5

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ow!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ugh, turns out that wasn't actual food. But you get the idea, Periodontal the Platypus.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Blink twice if I'm getting warmer.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Our sub should carry us deeper than anyone has ever been before. In meat.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: And a little extra yeast in the baguette will increase our overall maneuverability.

Name: Buford
Dialog: And what's the science behind this?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Please save your questions till the end.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Is it the end?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: No! And that is also a question.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Who are you?

Name: Oven Repairman
Dialog: I'm an oven repair guy, but I've got time to kill. Nowhere to be until a week from Tuesday.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (dials phone) Mom, Phineas and Ferb and some... oven repairman apparently are building a—

Name: Linda
Dialog: Honey, where are you? The sandcastle competition started.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Something, uh, big came up, and, uh...

Name: Linda
Dialog: Please, honey, don't tell me this is about the boys. Is this about the boys?

Name: Candace
Dialog: You just told me not to tell you.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Can you hear how disappointed my face looks?

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's okay, Mom, we'll be there soon, the helicopter's coming!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Wait, what?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (mockingly sweet) Who, me? Oh, I'm just an innocent stowaway. Hee-hee-hee-hee!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Alright, everybody, hop in!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah! Eat that, Periwinkle the Platypus!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey! No, no! Wait, wait! Wait, wait, wait! Timeout!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Timeout, that's my good china. (He gives some white plates to Perry.) Here. This is my bad china. Have at you.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We've done it! We're at the ocean floor!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Aha! I got you! Just wait till Mom sees... whatever all this is. (She gets out her phone.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, hey, Candace! Always room for one more! We're about to stick our flag in the deepest part of the ocean.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (putting down her phone) Um, is the Mariana Trench supposed to have two gross, bloodshot eyes?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No. Why do you ask?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (pointing out the window) That's why!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (gasps)

Name: Buford
Dialog: (screams like a little girl)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: We gotta get outta here!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Move over, Ferb! I've almost got my license!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: C'mon, gimme something good! Daddy needs a new pair of shoes, or, y'know, whatever the food equivalent of that is. (to Perry) You get it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah! Ow! Ow! (goes back to the inator) Grrr! Big money, big money, no whammy!

Name: Mother
Dialog: No dessert until your plate is clear.

Name: Mother
Dialog: Oh!

Name: Son
Dialog: Woohoo!

Name: Family
Dialog: Awwww...

Name: Rich Guy
Dialog: Luckily I'm wealthy and can afford more. (chuckles) I'm so alone.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Table! Table! Buffet! Ooh, prime rib! Wealthy!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Whoa! Whoa! Ooh!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Quick! We've only got one shot or this sub is toast! Hit the dead man's drop maneuver!

Name: Buford
Dialog: That doesn't sound very safe.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: It's safer than being eaten by a giant fish monster! (takes the wheel) Move over, Candace! Everybody, hold on!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: We may be doomed but these nimble fingers and five years of violin lessons can play us out in style.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's still gaining on us, and it's eating bits of our sub!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (stops playing) Perhaps in hindsight, we should not have made our submarine out of FOOD!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: We gotta get outta here!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Good thing we have an escape vehicle. It's our substitute submarine sandwich submarine.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: A sub sub sub, if you will.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We just have to open this hatch and we'll be home free.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: There is no handle! Why are there bite marks?!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Nobody packed any snacks.

Name: Candace
Dialog: We can't get into the escape pod?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We can't get in the escape pod, but maybe we can still use it. Isabella, swing around to starboard!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, eject the pod!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What?! But that's our only way out of—

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We just need to distract it. (to Ferb) Jettison the sub!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It was made of food, too. Everybody to your stations! We're surfacing!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, Mom, Mom! Mom! Mom! Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Where were you, sweetie? We're all waiting for your submission.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oho, come with me, Mom! I've got a submission, all right! A sub-mission! You will not believe your eyes!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Okay. I believe I won't believe my eyes.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: This was actually productive. This... This food fight is gonna feed me for weeks.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And thank you for washing your hands. Food safety and even-length shoelaces, two things people always take for granted—

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, has that time clock always been there?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (screams)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Nice serve!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, is that Love Händel? (crash!) Oh, that's gonna burn tomorrow!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Mom! Look!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, look!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, what? No! It was a real submarine, I swear!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, I get it, a submarine sandwich submarine sand sculpture! You've got such special skills, sweetie! You've really outdone yourself! I'm so proud of you, and I ran into a sandcastle college recruiter who thinks he can get you a scholarship.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh!

Name: Judge
Dialog: Ten out of ten!

Name: Candace
Dialog: But but but... I didn't do this!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Perry!

Name: Perry
Dialog: (chatters)

Name: Oven Repairman
Dialog: (looking at his watch) And, he missed his window.
